product_overview: A backend-driven document management and KYC registration system for vehicle owners, with an admin console for authentication, user profile management, document verification, retention cleanup, and AWS cost reporting. The platform stores files securely in S3, maintains versioned audit trails in PostgreSQL, and supports administrative operations through protected API endpoints.
core_goals: Enable public vehicle registration validation and KYC document submission
Provide secure admin-only authentication and session management
Allow administrators to search, inspect, create, and manage vehicle owner records
Support document versioning, verification, soft-deletion, and auditability
Enforce retention cleanup for expired documents and compliance needs
Expose pricing and actual cost insights for AWS storage and infrastructure planning

features.name: Admin Authentication
features.description: Authenticates the administrator and manages the secure session cookie used for all protected admin operations.
user_flows: POST /auth/admin-login with valid admin credentials -> Receive 200 response and access_token httpOnly cookie is set -> GET protected admin endpoints such as /admin/search with cookie -> Receive 200 authorized response
POST /auth/admin-login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Invalid admin credentials
POST /auth/admin-login when admin credentials are not configured -> Receive 500 Admin credentials not configured
POST /auth/logout with active admin session cookie -> Receive 200 response and access_token cookie is cleared

features.name: User KYC Registration
features.description: Provides a public flow for checking vehicle registration availability and submitting a new user profile with KYC documents uploaded to S3.
user_flows: GET /users/check-vehicle with an available vehicle registration number -> Receive 200 StatusResponse indicating availability -> POST /users/register with name, vehicle_reg_no, optional metadata, and PDF/JPEG/PNG documents -> Receive 200 StatusResponse and documents are stored in S3

GET /users/check-vehicle with an already registered vehicle registration number -> Receive 200 StatusResponse indicating the vehicle is not available -> POST /users/register with the same vehicle_reg_no -> Receive 400 Validation/Upload error
POST /users/register with invalid file type or malformed registration data -> Receive 400 Validation/Upload error
POST /users/register with valid KYC payload and multiple documents -> Receive 200 StatusResponse confirming atomic registration and upload

features.name: Admin User Management
features.description: Allows administrators to search user records, view detailed profiles and document links, manually create profiles, inspect version history, and review audit logs.
user_flows: GET /admin/search with valid admin cookie and pagination/filter parameters -> Receive 200 PaginatedSearchUserResponse with matching users -> GET /admin/user/{vehicle_reg_no} for a selected result -> Receive 200 UserDetailResponse with presigned document links
GET /admin/search without an authenticated admin cookie -> Receive 401 Unauthorized access
GET /admin/user/{vehicle_reg_no} for a non-existent vehicle registration number -> Receive 404 User not found
POST /admin/user/create with valid admin cookie and required user data -> Receive 200 StatusResponse and a new user profile is created
GET /admin/user/{vehicle_reg_no}/history/{doc_type} with valid admin cookie -> Receive 200 List[DocumentResponse] showing upload version history
GET /admin/user/{vehicle_reg_no}/audit with valid admin cookie -> Receive 200 List[AuditLogResponse] containing audit trail entries

features.name: Admin Document Actions
features.description: Lets administrators upload new document versions, verify or reject specific versions, soft-delete document versions, and delete entire user profiles and their associated files.
user_flows: POST /admin/user/{vehicle_reg_no}/upload with valid admin cookie and a new document version -> Receive 200 StatusResponse and the new version becomes available in version history
POST /admin/user/{vehicle_reg_no}/documents/{doc_id}/verify with verification decision and reason -> Receive 200 VerificationResponse confirming approved or rejected status
DELETE /admin/user/{vehicle_reg_no}/documents/{doc_id} with valid admin cookie and compliance reason -> Receive 200 StatusResponse, document is soft-deleted, and latest version may be promoted
DELETE /admin/user/{vehicle_reg_no} with valid admin cookie -> Receive 200 StatusResponse, all user documents are purged, audit records are removed, and the user profile is deleted
DELETE /admin/user/{vehicle_reg_no}/documents/{doc_id} for a missing or already deleted document -> Receive an error response and no active document state is changed

features.name: Data Retention & Compliance Cleanup
features.description: Runs a retention cleanup operation that identifies and purges documents older than the five-year retention threshold, with dry-run and execute support.
user_flows: POST /admin/retention/cleanup with valid admin cookie and dry-run mode -> Receive 200 StatusResponse showing documents eligible for purge without deleting them
POST /admin/retention/cleanup with valid admin cookie, execute mode, and required confirmation header -> Receive 200 StatusResponse and expired documents are permanently removed
POST /admin/retention/cleanup without valid admin authentication -> Receive 401 Unauthorized access
POST /admin/retention/cleanup without required confirmation for execution -> Receive error response and no purge is performed

features.name: Pricing & Cost Management
features.description: Provides administrative cost visibility and estimation for AWS usage, including current month-to-date actuals and projected storage/compute estimates under custom scenarios.
user_flows: GET /admin/costs/actual with valid admin cookie -> Receive 200 ActualCostsResponse with S3 and RDS actual spend and month-end projection
POST /admin/costs/estimate with valid admin cookie and usage inputs for S3, RDS, and EC2 -> Receive 200 CostEstimateResponse with detailed breakdown and total estimated cost
GET /admin/costs/actual without admin authentication -> Receive 401 Unauthorized access
POST /admin/costs/estimate with invalid or incomplete input values -> Receive error response and no estimate is returned
